summary: Kaniksu NF crow's nest: a 60-foot platform built in a tree about 1928 and abandoned in the 1940s; the platform appears gone, while the tree, wire and ladder stakes remain.

facts.design: 60-foot crow's nest platform built in a tree, climbed by stakes driven into the trunk
facts.status_note: The crow's nest platform appears to be gone. The tree it was built in was still standing in 2022, with a telephone wire and ladder stakes in the trunk.

access.note: Hike-in site on Kaniksu National Forest land, reached by a fair dirt access road and an abandoned spur road. None of the four sources mentions a closure or a permit.

visit.trail_note: About 0.6 miles one way from a switchback at about 2,680 feet on Gisborne Mountain Road (597B), along an abandoned spur road. There is no platform left to climb; the tree has old pegs and wire.

events.note: 60-foot crow's nest tree platform; firelookout.com says built about 1928
Abandoned in the 1940s (Kresek, as cited by two sites)
firelookout.com says the crow's nest was still there in the 1980s
Kresek's book, as quoted by the Idaho Fire Lookouts page, says the crow's nest was still there as of 2015
Two 2022 visits: the tree was still standing, the platform appears gone, and the telephone wire and ladder stakes remain

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says the crow's nest was still there in the 1980s, and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page quotes Kresek's book as saying 2015. Both 2022 visits found the tree standing; WillhiteWeb thought the platform was gone and the Idaho Fire Lookouts team found only the wire and stakes. Recorded as gone for the platform, with the tree still standing in 2022.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'gone' kept, scoped to the platform: 2022 visits found the tree standing with no platform. The FFLA index lists this site as 'Abandoned', not 'Gone', and the brief's 'firelookout_com=standing' does not match the firelookout.com text we read, which says 'still there in the 1980's'. No staffing sources; the Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it has no documented staffing history, so staffing is omitted. WillhiteWeb's photo caption '1927 Experimental Spur Tree' conflicts with the 1928 build date; not used. Access 'public' rests on no closure appearing in the sources. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page dated September 12, 2022 does not state the visit date.
